prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent pixel-art village building sprite atlas for an overhead 2D fantasy RPG. Make a square 3 by 3 uniform grid of NINE separate objects, one complete object centered in each equal square cell, transparent background, no ground tiles, no people, no labels, no text, no borders. Top-down three-quarter RPG view with fronts facing the bottom edge, orthographic, consistent light from upper left. Rich but restrained old-school pixel art with clearly stepped pixels, dark outlines, earthy timber, muted plaster, mossy stone, weathered grey-brown roofs, suitable for a dark woodland village. Each asset fits fully within its own cell with generous transparent margin on every side, no overlaps between cells. Reading order: row 1 col 1 a two-storey rustic timber-and-plaster INN with a wooden cup-shaped hanging sign and amber windows; row 1 col 2 a modest GENERAL STORE with a muted olive cloth awning and a few crates; row 1 col 3 a BLACKSMITH workshop with dark stone chimney, attached open forge glowing warm orange, an anvil and tools. Row 2 col 1 an APOTHECARY cottage with a faded sage-green roof, drying herbs and bottle-shaped wooden sign; row 2 col 2 a simple humble thatched HOME with closed shutters; row 2 col 3 a smaller slate-roofed HOME with woodpile. Row 3 col 1 a rectangular open MARKET STALL with faded rust-and-beige striped canopy and baskets of vegetables; row 3 col 2 a circular STONE WELL with a small wooden shingle roof and bucket; row 3 col 3 a small timber WATCH HUT with an attached lantern and a short palisade section, no guards. Keep all objects separately isolated on genuine alpha transparency. Buildings must look like usable in-game scenery, not UI icons or isometric diamond tiles. Desired canvas 2048 by 2048.
